account.heading: Login info
account.intro: The info you use to sign in to Kimaru.
danger.confirmIntro: To confirm, enter your registered email address.
danger.desc: Deleting your account permanently removes all data — bookings, contacts, calendar connection — and cannot be undone.
danger.heading: Delete your account
danger.jsConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account? All data will be removed and this cannot be undone.
danger.jsDone: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for using Kimaru.
danger.paidNote: You can't delete your account while on a paid plan. Please cancel your subscription in Square and return to the free plan first, then delete your account.
hero.heading: Settings
integrations.heading: Calendar integration
integrations.intro: Connect Google Calendar to publish only the open slots that don't clash with your schedule, and auto-create the event plus a Google Meet on booking.
integrations.zoomNote: Meeting-notes app integration is coming soon.
js.calendarConnectError: Could not finish connecting. Please sign in again and retry.
js.calendarConnected: ✓ Google Calendar is connected. Availability checks, event creation, and Meet links are active.
js.calendarDisconnected: Not connected. Connecting enables availability checks and event creation.
js.disconnectConfirm: This will disconnect Google Calendar. Are you sure?
js.premiumIntro: You're on the Premium plan. You get all Pro features plus AI Assist. Thank you, always.
js.zoomConnectError: Zoom connection failed. Please try again.
js.zoomConnected: ✓ Zoom is connected. Bookings with the “Zoom” meeting type get a URL issued under your name.
js.zoomDisconnected: Not connected. Connect to auto-issue Zoom meeting URLs on booking.
js.zoomTestFail: Connection test failed. Please disconnect and connect again.
js.zoomTestOk: ✓ Connection test succeeded. The test meeting was deleted after creation.
logout.desc: Logging in again requires your registered account. Your data is kept.
logout.heading: Account actions
logout.title: Log out from this device
plan.cancelDesc: Billing is managed by Square. To cancel, use "Manage subscription" in the payment confirmation email from Square, or Square's billing dashboard. After that, you won't be charged from the next renewal date. If unsure, contact us.
plan.freeIntro: Upgrade to Pro to unlock contact management (meeting notes, impression scores), bookings up to 6 months ahead, 2 booking pages, advanced profile, 3 pinpoint scheduling links with slot holds, and more. AI Assist is on the Premium plan (5 booking pages). The Cat Key is here too.
plan.heading: Your plan
plan.proIntro: You're on Pro. Thank you, always.
zoom.heading: Zoom connection
zoom.intro: Connect your own Zoom account, and bookings with the “Zoom” meeting type automatically get a meeting URL issued under your name and shared with the guest.
zoom.testNote: "Test connection" creates one test meeting and deletes it right away to confirm meetings can actually be issued. Real meetings are created automatically when a booking comes in with the "Zoom" meeting type.
